summary: BlackLine, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its board approved a $100 million increase to its existing stock buyback program, raising total authorization to $600 million. As of August 3, 2026, the company had repurchased 7.2 million shares for $327.8 million. Repurchases may occur via open market transactions under Rule 10b-18 or privately negotiated deals, and the company may use Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program is discretionary and can be suspended or modified at any time. Watch for continued buyback execution and potential balance-sheet impact.
